entries.text: Always the shipped shell: live-site ShellHeader + collapsed ShellSidebar (96px). Never invent a BETONLINE wordmark header.
No Tabler, no hand-drawn icons, no ToggleGroup rings. Use ShellIcon / Storybook / Lumen.
When a Figma frame or screenshot is given, match it. Do not redesign. Testing ground first; live stays locked until approved.
Casino sub-nav is one muted rounded track with pills inside — not separate shadowed cards. Search and heart sit on the same track.
Big win or first deposit: one short toast. Confetti only on a real level-up / VIP tick — once, then quiet.
entries.why: Celebrate the moment, don't wallpaper the lobby.

entries.text: Failed bet, failed payment, or a form error: toast only. Never confetti.
entries.why: Errors need a clear recovery, not a party.

entries.text: Favourite a game: heart fills. No toast, no confetti.
